# apicurio_rule (Data Source)

Reads an Apicurio Registry rule (global or per-artifact).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `rule_type` (String) Rule type, e.g. `COMPATIBILITY`, `VALIDITY`.

### Optional

- `artifact_id` (String) Artifact ID (required when scope=artifact).
- `group_id` (String) Group ID (required when scope=artifact).
- `scope` (String) Rule scope: `global` or `artifact`. Defaults to `global`.

### Read-Only

- `config` (String) Rule configuration value.
- `enabled` (Boolean) True if the rule exists.
- `id` (String) Internal Terraform ID. Global: `global/<rule_type>`. Artifact: `<group_id>/<artifact_id>/<rule_type>`.
